name: Central Delaware Valley

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon, Cabernet Franc and Tempranillo fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely. Shale and mudstone are fine-grained rocks that hold heat well and are moderately fertile.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
